text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Recreation...? Did we not gather them
here for tandem training?
choice_data_list: 本日は、少々趣向を変えてみようかと
choice_data_list_en: Today, I thought we might try something a little different.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since she enrolled, she has kept herself wound tight,
so I felt it necessary to help her unwind.
That is why today—
choice_data_list: ご級友のみなさまと『鬼ごっこ』を、と
choice_data_list_en: A game of 'tag' with your classmates, was it?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, how wonderful.
Then... how about playing chain tag?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's start, right this second!
Pisa brought it up, so she's 'It'! Ready, set, go!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What cowardice, Light O-san!
*I* am the one who flees faster and farther!!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Come now, Rose-chan, let's run along too.
This way~.

text_block_list.name: Sprint Duo
text_block_list.text:
“I'm the fastest at getting caught, too!!”
“That's nothing to brag about!!”

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Now then, just two more.
Let's all hold hands together♪

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Phew... haah...! Tag is quite the exhausting endeavor, it seems...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Still, the more young'uns link hands, the slower they'll get.
Let's grit our teeth and outrun 'em... Hup, there we go!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, the two of you are quite formidable...!
Even so, I will catch you...!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I will stay in the lead until the very end...!
HAAAAAAAHHHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, time is up...
And here I thought I was just one step away from holding your hand...
Fufu, you truly are magnificent, Rose-san.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
No, it was your pursuit that was splendid.
...Heh. This is quite...
The diversions of the common folk are truly fascinating.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
And you as well, Trainer. Incorporating training
into play... What a splendid idea.
